Yuqorida o'ngda QIZIL yorliqda oq '11', chapida 'Our Precious Planet'.

CHAP USTUN:
• To'q sariq 'Communication: Giving Advice'.
21) Kasseta belgisi: 'Listen and fill in the missing words. Listen again and repeat.' 1 A: I can't lose weight. B: If ..........., I would try to eat fewer cakes and sweets. 2 A: I feel very tired after work. B: You ........ work fewer hours. 3 A: I can't stand driving in that heavy traffic every morning. B: You .......... start cycling to work.
• To'q sariq 'Vocabulary Revision Game'.
22) 'In teams, use the words/phrases below to make sentences. Each correct sentence gets one point.' Qiya: 'water shortages, leader, ban cars, hunt, endangered species, plant trees, save, survive, waste water, repair pipes, water supplies, destroy, pollute'.
• Katta to'q sariq 'Pronunciation'.
23) Kasseta belgisi: 'Listen and underline the unstressed syllables with the sound /ə/ in them. Listen again and repeat.' 'com·pa·ny' (pa tagiga chizilgan - namuna), 'an·swer', 'e·ven', 'in·for·ma·tion', 'let·ter', 'pol·lu·tion', 'ma·chine', 'A·me·ri·ca'.
• Katta to'q sariq 'Writing (an article suggesting solutions to problems)'.
   TO'Q SARIQ RAMKA: 'When we write an ARTICLE SUGGESTING SOLUTIONS TO PROBLEMS we can divide it into FIVE paragraphs. In the FIRST PARAGRAPH we state the PROBLEM. In the NEXT PARAGRAPHS (2, 3 and 4) we write our suggested solutions to the problem. We write each suggestion with results/examples in a separate paragraph. In the LAST PARAGRAPH we SUMMARISE OUR OPINION. We normally use PRESENT TENSES and CONDITIONALS TYPE 2 in such articles.'

O'NG USTUN:
24) Kasseta belgisi: a) 'Look at the pictures. Listen, then say which picture is not mentioned.' b) 'Read the suggestions and match them to the results, then make sentences, as in the example.' SURATLAR: A - to'rga o'ralgan toshbaqa (dengiz ifloslanishi); B - tirband yo'l (mashinalar); C - qurilish krani (qurilish); D - axlat uyumi.
   YIRTIQ QOG'OZ 'suggestions': put bins on every street corner; have more trees/green areas; improve public transport; people use bicycles; people recycle things; create more parks. 'results': people have more oxygen; not be so much rubbish everywhere; people not drop litter in streets; people leave cars at home; children be able to play safely; cities be less polluted. Ko'k strelka: 'put bins on every street corner' → 'people not drop litter in streets'.
   Ko'k qiya: 'If the authorities put rubbish bins on every street corner, people wouldn't drop litter in the streets.'
25) 'Your school magazine has asked its readers to send in articles answering the question: HOW CAN WE MAKE OUR CITIES MORE ENVIRONMENTALLY FRIENDLY? Write your article (120 - 180 words) using the plan below and ideas from Ex. 24. Use the text in Ex. 16 as a model.'
   SPIRAL DAFTAR 'Plan': Introduction - Para 1: state the problem. Main Body - Para 2: suggestion 1 + result/example; Para 3: suggestion 2 + result/example; Para 4: suggestion 3 + result/example. Conclusion - Para 5: summarise your opinion.
• Katta to'q sariq 'Words of Wisdom': 'Read the sentences below. What do they mean?' Ramkada: • 'If every person swept their own doorstep, the city would soon be clean.' • 'It is never too late to mend.'

Bet raqami: pastda o'ngda '81'.

exercises.explanationUz:
⚠ Audio yo'q bo'lsa - maslahat
qoliplaridan foydalaning.


MASLAHAT BERISh QOLIPLARI:

  • If I WERE YOU, I would ...
    = Sening o'rningda bo'lsam ...
  • You SHOULD ...
    = ... kerak.
  • You COULD ...
    = ... mumkin edi (yumshoq).


JAVOBLAR:

  1 If I WERE YOU, I would try to
    eat fewer cakes and sweets.
  2 You SHOULD work fewer hours.
  3 You COULD start cycling to work.


⚠ 'TO LOSE WEIGHT':

  = ozmoq, vazn yo'qotmoq.
  ⚠ 'weight' /weɪt/ = vazn.
  ⚠ 'put on weight' = semirmoq.


⚠ 'FEWER CAKES':

  = kamroq tort. Sanaladigan →
  'fewer'.
  ⚠ 'fewer hours' - soatlar ham
  sanaladi.


⚠ 'I CAN'T STAND + -ING':

  = ... toqat qila olmayman.
  'I can't stand DRIVING'.


⚠ 'HEAVY TRAFFIC':

  = tirbandlik (og'ir harakat).
  ⚠ 'traffic' SANALMAYDIGAN.


⚠ 'TO START + -ING':

  'start CYCLING' = velosipedda
  yurishni boshlamoq.

sections.title: Writing (an article suggesting solutions to problems)

exercises.instructionEn: When we write an article suggesting solutions to problems we can divide it into five paragraphs.
exercises.instructionUz: Muammolarga yechim taklif qiluvchi maqola yozganda uni besh xatboshiga bo'lishimiz mumkin.
exercises.explanationUz:
MAQOLA TUZILIShI (5 XATBOShI):

  1 - MUAMMO (state the problem)
  2 - 1-taklif + natija/misol
  3 - 2-taklif + natija/misol
  4 - 3-taklif + natija/misol
  5 - XULOSA (fikringizni
      umumlashtiring)

  ⚠ ZAMONLAR: hozirgi zamonlar +
  2-tur shart gaplari.


⚠ 'TO DIVIDE INTO':

  = ...ga bo'lmoq.


⚠ 'TO STATE':

  = bayon qilmoq, aytmoq.


⚠ 'SEPARATE':

  = alohida. /ˈsepərət/ (sifat).


⚠ 'TO SUMMARISE':

  = umumlashtirmoq, xulosa qilmoq.
  ⚠ AmE 'summarize'.


⚠ 'NORMALLY':

  = odatda.

points.en: In the first paragraph we state the problem.
In the next paragraphs (2, 3 and 4) we write our suggested solutions to the problem. We write each suggestion with results/examples in a separate paragraph.
points.uz: Keyingi xatboshilarda (2, 3 va 4) muammoga taklif qilgan yechimlarimizni yozamiz. Har bir taklifni natija/misollari bilan alohida xatboshida yozamiz.

points.en: In the last paragraph we summarise our opinion.
We normally use present tenses and conditionals type 2 in such articles.
points.uz: Bunday maqolalarda odatda hozirgi zamonlar va 2-tur shart gaplarini ishlatamiz.

exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  'If the authorities PUT rubbish
   bins on every street corner,
   people WOULDN'T DROP litter in
   the streets.'


MOSLASh va GAPLAR:

  put bins on every street corner
    → people not drop litter
  have more trees/green areas
    → people have more oxygen
  improve public transport
    → people leave cars at home
  people use bicycles
    → cities be less polluted
  people recycle things
    → not be so much rubbish
  create more parks
    → children be able to play
      safely


⚠ 'THE AUTHORITIES':

  = hokimiyat, rasmiy idoralar.


⚠ 'A STREET CORNER':

  = ko'cha burchagi.


⚠ 'OXYGEN':

  = kislorod. /ˈɒksɪdʒən/.


⚠ 'TO IMPROVE':

  = yaxshilamoq.


⚠ 'PUBLIC TRANSPORT':

  = jamoat transporti.


⚠ 'SAFELY':

  = xavfsiz (ravish).
  ⚠ 'safe' = xavfsiz (sifat).


⚠ 'LESS POLLUTED':

  = kamroq ifloslangan.

Quyidagi reja va 24-mashqdagi g'oyalardan foydalanib maqolangizni (120-180 so'z) yozing. 16-mashqdagi matndan namuna sifatida foydalaning.

structure.modelEn: Our cities are becoming more and more polluted. There is rubbish everywhere, the air is dirty because of the traffic and there are very few green areas. What can we do to make our cities more environmentally friendly?
structure.modelUz: Shaharlarimiz tobora ifloslanmoqda. Hamma yerda axlat, havo tirbandlik tufayli iflos va yashil hududlar juda kam. Shaharlarimizni atrof-muhitga do'stroq qilish uchun nima qila olamiz?

structure.modelEn: First of all, the authorities could put rubbish bins on every street corner. If they did this, people wouldn't drop litter in the streets and our cities would be much cleaner.
structure.modelUz: Avvalo, hokimiyat har ko'cha burchagiga axlat qutisi qo'yishi mumkin. Agar shunday qilsa, odamlar ko'chaga axlat tashlamasdi va shaharlarimiz ancha toza bo'lardi.

structure.modelEn: Secondly, the authorities should improve public transport. If buses and trains were cheaper and faster, people would leave their cars at home and there would be less air pollution.
structure.modelUz: Ikkinchidan, hokimiyat jamoat transportini yaxshilashi kerak. Agar avtobus va poyezdlar arzonroq va tezroq bo'lsa, odamlar mashinalarini uyda qoldirardi va havo ifloslanishi kamayardi.

structure.modelEn: Finally, we could create more parks and plant more trees. If there were more green areas, people would have more oxygen and children would be able to play safely.
structure.modelUz: Nihoyat, ko'proq bog' yaratib, ko'proq daraxt ekishimiz mumkin. Agar ko'proq yashil hudud bo'lsa, odamlarda ko'proq kislorod bo'lardi va bolalar xavfsiz o'ynay olardi.

structure.modelEn: All in all, there are many things we can do to make our cities greener. If we all worked together, our cities would be cleaner, healthier and nicer places to live in.
structure.modelUz: Umuman olganda, shaharlarimizni yashilroq qilish uchun qila oladigan ko'p ishlarimiz bor. Agar hammamiz birga ishlasak, shaharlarimiz yashash uchun tozaroq, sog'lomroq va yoqimliroq joylar bo'lardi.

modelAnswers:
Our cities are becoming more and more polluted. There is rubbish everywhere, the air is dirty because of the traffic and there are very few green areas. What can we do to make our cities more environmentally friendly?

First of all, the authorities could put rubbish bins on every street corner. If they did this, people wouldn't drop litter in the streets and our cities would be much cleaner.

Secondly, the authorities should improve public transport. If buses and trains were cheaper and faster, people would leave their cars at home and there would be less air pollution.

Finally, we could create more parks and plant more trees. If there were more green areas, people would have more oxygen and children would be able to play safely.

All in all, there are many things we can do to make our cities greener. If we all worked together, our cities would be cleaner, healthier and nicer places to live in.
modelAnswersUz:
Shaharlarimiz tobora ifloslanmoqda. Hamma yerda axlat, havo tirbandlik tufayli iflos va yashil hududlar juda kam. Shaharlarimizni atrof-muhitga do'stroq qilish uchun nima qila olamiz?

Avvalo, hokimiyat har ko'cha burchagiga axlat qutisi qo'yishi mumkin. Agar shunday qilsa, odamlar ko'chaga axlat tashlamasdi va shaharlarimiz ancha toza bo'lardi.

Ikkinchidan, hokimiyat jamoat transportini yaxshilashi kerak. Agar avtobus va poyezdlar arzonroq va tezroq bo'lsa, odamlar mashinalarini uyda qoldirardi va havo ifloslanishi kamayardi.

Nihoyat, ko'proq bog' yaratib, ko'proq daraxt ekishimiz mumkin. Agar ko'proq yashil hudud bo'lsa, odamlarda ko'proq kislorod bo'lardi va bolalar xavfsiz o'ynay olardi.

Umuman olganda, shaharlarimizni yashilroq qilish uchun qila oladigan ko'p ishlarimiz bor. Agar hammamiz birga ishlasak, shaharlarimiz yashash uchun tozaroq, sog'lomroq va yoqimliroq joylar bo'lardi.

exercises.instructionEn: Read the sentences below. What do they mean?
exercises.instructionUz: Quyidagi gaplarni o'qing. Ular nimani anglatadi?
exercises.explanationUz:
1) 'If every person swept their
   own doorstep, the city would
   soon be clean.'
   = Har kim o'z ostonasini supursa,
   shahar tez orada toza bo'lardi.
   MA'NOSI: har kim o'z ulushini
   qo'shsa, katta muammo hal bo'ladi.
   ⚠ 2-tur shart gapi!

2) 'It is never too late to mend.'
   = Tuzatish uchun hech qachon kech
   emas.
   MA'NOSI: xatoni tuzatishni istalgan
   vaqtda boshlash mumkin.


⚠ 'TO SWEEP':

  swept - swept. = supurmoq.


⚠ 'A DOORSTEP':

  = ostona (eshik oldi).


⚠ 'TO MEND':

  = tuzatmoq, ta'mirlamoq.
  ⚠ 'mend your ways' = o'zini
  tuzatmoq.


⚠ 'THEIR OWN':

  'every person ... THEIR' - umumiy
  'his/her' o'rniga 'their'.

items.en: If every person swept their own doorstep, the city would soon be clean.
items.uz: Agar har kim o'z ostonasini supursa, shahar tez orada toza bo'lardi.
items.answerEn: If everyone did their small part, big problems would be solved. We should all take responsibility for our own actions.
items.answerUz: Agar har kim o'z kichik ulushini qo'shsa, katta muammolar hal bo'lardi. Hammamiz o'z harakatlarimiz uchun mas'uliyatni olishimiz kerak.

items.en: It is never too late to mend.
items.uz: Tuzatish uchun hech qachon kech emas.
items.answerEn: You can always start to correct your mistakes or change your bad habits, no matter how late it seems.
items.answerUz: Qanchalik kech ko'rinmasin, xatolaringizni tuzatishni yoki yomon odatlaringizni o'zgartirishni har doim boshlashingiz mumkin.

sentencePatterns.introUz: Maslahat berish va yechim taklif qilish qoliplari.

patterns.formula: If I were you, I would + FE'L.
patterns.exampleEn: If I were you, I would try to eat fewer sweets.
patterns.exampleUz: Sening o'rningda bo'lsam, kamroq shirinlik yeyishga harakat qilardim.

patterns.exampleEn: You should work fewer hours. You could start cycling to work.
patterns.exampleUz: Kamroq soat ishlashing kerak. Ishga velosipedda yurishni boshlashing mumkin.

patterns.formula: If the authorities + PAST SIMPLE, people would(n't) + FE'L.
patterns.exampleEn: If the authorities put bins on every corner, people wouldn't drop litter.
patterns.exampleUz: Agar hokimiyat har burchakka quti qo'ysa, odamlar axlat tashlamasdi.

patterns.exampleEn: I can't stand driving in heavy traffic.
patterns.exampleUz: Tirbandlikda mashina haydashga toqat qila olmayman.
